title: Chile
goal: Read about DINA's clandestine detention network at Villa Grimaldi, and the unexpected 1988 plebiscite that ended Pinochet's seventeen years in power -- not the 1973 coup, already covered.

items: Explain what DINA was and what it directed, 1974-1977.
Explain why Pinochet called the October 1988 plebiscite.
Describe Pinochet's role after losing the plebiscite.
Use en aras de to name a stated higher justification.
I can explain what DINA was and what it directed, 1974-1977.
